title: I100: rule PAR_record_round_trip: the record law over an encoder into a byte record and its getter family, the constant read-back laws, and the back-test's record bridges (L7 candidate; RG-M3-01 to RG-M3-03 and RG-M3-06; F-M3-08, F-M3-10)

thresholds.base: 4fd64a52 (the lead after #131, which filed RG-M3-06), with BUILD_PLAN's row I100 (1d889c88)
thresholds.reply: I100 ready: PR #<n> <head sha>, 12 laws added, 0 statuses moved, back-test exit blockers 4 -> 1, B0 red (awaiting signature)

predictions.claim: Obligation (2): six constant_read laws, exactly the instrument's: enc_sol's SequencerSetVerifyHash at versions 0, 1 and 2 (32 zero bytes, premise version = N) and the Version slot of BatchHeaderV0_Bytes (0x00, v0), BatchHeaderV1_Bytes (0x01, v1) and BatchCache_createBatchHeaderWithSequencerSetHash (0x02, v2), without premises; they are I25's six constant_read elements; each PROVED by open_refl, BendTT's verdict checked.

Obligations (3) and (4): six record laws, exactly the instrument's, with 12 conjuncts (enc_sol v0, BatchHeaderV0_Bytes v0) or 13 (enc_sol v1 and v2, BatchHeaderV1_Bytes v1, BatchCache v2), each PROVED by open_refl, BendTT's verdict checked; the par_record basis at HEAD has no obstruction.
Obligation (1): every field conjunct of a record law is the claim, under the same premises, of the round_trip law L_par_rt_<e>_<d>_v<N>, PROVED at HEAD and at the base.
12 laws added and 0 statuses moved: the M3 registry at HEAD is the base's plus the 12 (every base hash kept) under holon-rules/1.16; every M3 record of the base keeps its status.

Obligation (5): the back-test pairs L_rt_go_v0, _v1 and _v2 with L_par_rec_enc_sol_BatchHeaderBytes_v0, _v1 and _v2, bridges dec_go, enc_sol and view PROVED, acceptance bridges; the other five rows are the base's; the exit blockers go from 4 to 1 (gap:M0:L_par_hdr_v2).

Round 3's m08 is caught, obstructed: (enc_sol, BatchHeaderBytes, N) for N = 0, 1 and 2, each missing exactly BatchHeaderBytes_ParentBatchHash and BatchHeaderBytes_SequencerSetVerifyHash; no instance dropped.

Round 3's m06 is caught, refuted: no obstruction; the mutant's L_par_rec_enc_sol_BatchHeaderBytes_v1 has 12 conjuncts (no LastBlockNumber getter); the mutant's back-test pairs L_rt_go_v1 with it, its dec_go and view bridges REFUTED by Bend-checked counter-laws and its enc_sol bridge PROVED; gap:M0:L_rt_go_v1 is an exit blocker.

Round 3's m07 is caught, obstructed: (BatchHeaderV1_Bytes, BatchHeaderBytes, 1) and (BatchCache_createBatchHeaderWithSequencerSetHash, BatchHeaderBytes, 2), each missing exactly BatchHeaderBytes_LastBlockNumber and BatchHeaderBytes_ParentBatchHash; enc_sol's instances are HEAD's.
Round 3's m05 is not caught: the block-context functions are in no linked codec document, so the mutant's instances are HEAD's and its verdict is not_caught.

regressions.claim: The contract docstring, the instrument and the record map keep the sha256 pinned in thresholds.
holon audit prereg --milestone M3 prints PREREG OK.
The instrument imports nothing from holon/ or tools/.
The record map spec/M3/lib/backtest_record_map.json is the instrument's computation (record_map_doc).
I100's own commits write no frozen root.
B0: holon audit gaps admits PAR_record_round_trip (L7 (c), the human's signature); red until the signature lands.
B1: Catalog holon-rules/1.16: holon-rules/1.15's rules by the same producer objects plus PAR's constant_read and record_round_trip; catalog_version(M3) is holon-rules/1.16.
B2: holon.rules.par_record over the committed codec document is the instrument's computation, and gen/M3/par_record/basis.json is its document.

B3: Coverage reads the getter family: the m08-like plant obstructs (enc_sol, BatchHeaderBytes, 1) naming ParentBatchHash and SequencerSetVerifyHash and states neither law; the m06-like plant gives 12 conjuncts at version 1 and no obstruction; each as the instrument computes it.
B4: A conjunction decides: each record law's LAWS.bend is its exs telescope, and a planted wrong constant conjunct is REFUTED with that conjunct as the failing one.
B5: The back-test pairs exactly L_rt_go_vN with L_par_rec_enc_sol_BatchHeaderBytes_vN under the record map and names the record map in its table.
B6: No law id and no target name in the lines I100 adds under holon/.
B7: The par_record part is deterministic and reproduces the committed basis and law files byte for byte.
B8: CI runs the module's TestBuild in a job of its own.
